data.name: Luke
data.gender_notes: Luke is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek Loukas, associated with lux/light or with Lucania in southern Italy. Its root is Greek loukas. Luke the Evangelist; the Gospel of Luke. Luke is a Greek name meaning “Light-giving; from Lucania”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Luke expresses “Light-giving; from Lucania”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek Loukas, associated with lux/light or with Lucania in southern Italy.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luke total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
